canonical_project: Graven Hill D1 Site data centre (Bicester)

location.country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

notes: Eight-building data centre campus at Graven Hill adjacent St David's Barracks, Bicester (Cherwell DC); outline 22/01829/OUT granted 10 Oct 2023; reserved matters submitted Dec 2025; ~104,008 sqm; max power output ~435MW per Oxfordshire press (Aug 2026 approval report); decision on RMA delayed Apr 2026 then approved per local press.
